work.title: Die Walküre, WWV 86B
work.movement: Ride of the Valkyries — orchestral excerpt

version.value: Orchestral concert excerpt from the opening of Act III
version.note: No singers are credited. The acoustic-recording arrangement, exact cuts and instrumental substitutions are not documented; a full-opera orchestration timeline is therefore withheld.

performers.note: Conductor unknown. This historical recording ensemble is not identified with Leopold Stokowski’s orchestra founded in 1962.

date.note: December 1921 is the release date, not a verified session month.

place.note: The source does not establish the session venue.

label.note: Original Edison disc identified by the institutional catalogue.

matrixTakeSides.note: The institution’s complete matrix string is preserved without attempting to decode its suffixes.

credits.value: National Park Service digitisation; Adam Cuerden, Commons noise reduction and equalisation
credits.note: NPS is the institutional source, not a named engineer. The current Commons version restores Adam Cuerden’s processing after a later alternative edit.

date.note: This is the upload date of the documented processed version, not the date of the original NPS digitisation; the current-file revision is dated 29 May 2010.

processing.value: Hiss reduced by noise removal/equalisation; a beat removed near the start.
processing.note: These are the upload description’s claims. No unrecorded pitch correction, original horn substitutions or side cuts are inferred.

digital.format: Wikimedia MP3 access derivative of the processed Ogg Vorbis file, derived from the NPS digitisation

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: Wagner died in 1883. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance of every edition.

recording.value: US public domain: the record was published in December 1921.
recording.note: The established publication date independently supplies the US basis. This does not rely on the Commons Edison-donation template as a blanket worldwide licence.

rights.creditLine: Wagner: Ride of the Valkyries; American Symphony Orchestra, Edison Diamond Disc 80638-R, 1921. National Park Service / Thomas Edison National Historical Park; processed Commons file by Adam Cuerden. US public domain.
